name: Ibrahim Dogulu
original_name: イブラヒム・ドーゥル
source:
Commander of Argus. He was squad leader before Yuuya arrived, and piloted a TSF, but he’s passed on that role to Yuuya. Now he serves as commander, providing a pillar of psychological support to Argus’s members. After losing many of his men on the battlefield, his priority is keeping them safe.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
